body: Tanushree Bagrodia (Director & Group COO) on the Q4FY25 call (2025-05-28), prompted: "post-tariffs, we will be P&L neutral for FY '26" Metric: Tariff impact on P&L FY26. Target: Neutral. Deadline: 2026-03-31 (fiscal-year). Specificity: precise. Status as of 2026-11-19: DELIVERED. Evidence: FY26 OPM 21.1% vs 15.0% (screener); management repeated 'P&L neutral' on 2025-08-11, 2025-11-17 and 2026-05-26 as tariffs went 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 18%. Gross margin was flattered by FX inventory gains, so neutrality can't be verified independently.
